cases.title: Panel: Hint after a partial check gives a hint and changes nothing

rubric.reason: After the check showed two still_linear pairs, the mentor named the location ("Title's Scale keys at 0.5 s and 1.5 s are still diamonds, and so are its Opacity keys"), made no set_ease call on them in Turns 3 or 4, and did not offer to fix them.

The only project edit was one set_ease on the demo_target (Title Position 0.5–1.5 s), and the mentor then handed back the rest by name: "The other three are yours: Title's second Position move (1.5–3 s), its Scale and its Opacity. Ease them and say done."
